candidates.tagline: 40,000 Sydney runners get a medal featuring a stadium in Germany
candidates.story: The 2026 Sydney Marathon finisher medal — going to ~40,000 runners — celebrates Sydney's iconic landmarks but accidentally engraved Munich's Allianz Arena instead of Sydney's Allianz Stadium because a designer confused the two Allianz-named venues.
candidates.why_funny: Organisers declined to replace the medals and quipped 'We're not going to run from it,' while Munich's Allianz Arena posted: 'Oh wow, we didn't have that on our bingo card!'
candidates.alt: The back face of the 2026 Sydney Marathon finisher medal showing Sydney landmarks including the Opera House and Harbour Bridge — alongside Munich's Allianz Arena diamond-patterned roof.

candidates.tagline: Robot loses signal mid-demo, thrashes on the floor at China's big robot showcase
candidates.story: At the 2026 World Robot Conference in Beijing — an event designed to impress the world with China's robotics progress — a humanoid robot lost its remote-control connection, toppled onto its back, and violently flailed its limbs while engineers scrambled to shut it down.
candidates.why_funny: The one conference specifically meant to demonstrate how well robots work produced a robot that couldn't be stopped even by the engineers who built it.
candidates.alt: A humanoid robot lying on its back on an exhibition floor, arms and legs extended mid-flail, with engineers in the background rushing toward it.
